scene.speaker: maya
scene.bubble: Today's science lesson: the human body! Kili, you have wings — but have you got elbows?

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the body words.

words.clue: It is between your neck and your arm. You carry a rucksack on it.
Your food goes here. It hurts when you eat too much!
It is inside your mouth. You need it to talk and to taste.
Hair that grows on a man's chin.

activities.title: Match the body part with the action.

pairs.right: you taste ice cream with it
you carry your school bag on them
you play the piano with them
you wear a scarf round it

activities.title: Listen. Maya describes a funny monster. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Maya: Kili, look at this drawing of my monster! … Maya: It has got three eyes and a very long green tongue. … Maya: It has got four arms, so it has got four elbows too! … Maya: On its face it has got a purple moustache. … Maya: Its stomach is enormous because it eats twenty pizzas every day. … Maya: And look — it has got wings on its shoulders, just like you!

data.text: Student A draws a monster in one minute. Student B asks questions to draw the same monster without looking: "How many eyes has it got? Has it got a beard?" Compare the drawings and laugh!

homework.prompt: Draw your own monster and label 6 body parts. Write two sentences: It has got three knees. It has got a long blue tongue.
